surfaces.label: Conversation joins, sender attribution, timestamps, and sync integrity
surfaces.notes: Reviewed canonical chat relationships, exact integer watermarks, reactions, receipts, lifecycle changes, copied fingerprints, live integrity, and cursor pagination.

surfaces.label: Attributed-body decoding and contact resolution
surfaces.notes: Reviewed fixed executable invocation, limits, Foundation allowlists, certified legacy frames, malformed inputs, and process termination.

surfaces.label: Search indexing, analytics, and query budgets
surfaces.notes: Reviewed memory-only indexes, exact and substring modes, wildcard handling, source preflight, memory ceilings, frozen traversals, and set-based analytics.

surfaces.label: Privacy ceilings, errors, warnings, summaries, and diagnostics
surfaces.notes: Reviewed full, redacted, and aggregate projection plus post-projection assertions, response bounds, error detail allowlisting, and stderr diagnostics.

surfaces.notes: Reviewed AES-256-GCM encoding, size checks, lineage anchors, token-file no-follow handling, and cross-database rejection.
